# Conway circuit dependencies

life-circuit.js and life-hash.js are adapted from xiaoxuhui/logic-circuit under MIT (full notice retained in both files).

life-timed-tiles.js contains phase-aligned gate patterns by Magnus O. Myreen and Mario Carneiro, based on Nicholas Carlini’s designs. Licensed CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Source: https://github.com/CakeML/game-of-life/tree/master/gates . Paper: https://doi.org/10.4230/LIPIcs.ITP.2025.25 . The tile data was copied from Logic Workshop; only its JavaScript module wrapper was changed.
